create_store_with_capacity: create a Store instance with a custom capacity to manage inventory items in a bounded space
put_item_in_store: put an Item into the Store at a specific position or auto-assign an available slot
remove_item_by_code: remove an Item from the Store by its product code and clean up all position mappings
list_valid_items: list all valid items currently in the Store that pass the check validation method
find_item_position: find the position index of an Item in the Store by its product code
